query:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right midfielder, Bob is playing center midfielder, and Claire is playing striker.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Bob trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Finally, Bob and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) right midfielder
(B) center midfielder
(C) striker
note: UNLABELED external package; reference = first successful rollout; all other successful rollouts are omitted so the annotator view matches annotate.py

steps.content: To determine Bob's final position, track the position changes step-by-step and identify where he ends up after all swaps.

To determine Bob's final position, track each position swap sequentially: start with Bob in center midfielder, have him swap with Alice to become right midfielder, then swap with Claire to become striker, resulting in the answer being (C) striker.
